Bony bridging of the sella turcica; pituitary dysfunction is not established.
Testicular germ-cell tumor arises in reproductive tissue; endocrine dysfunction is not part of its definition.
Structural skeletal myopathy; respiratory insufficiency in 30-79% reflects respiratory muscle weakness, without established intrinsic lung damage.

Infectious inflammation of the liver capsule associated with gonococcal or chlamydial pelvic inflammatory disease.
Disorder of esophageal and esophageal sphincter motor function.
The syndrome names defining epimetaphyseal skeletal dysplasia and cataract; no additional organ evidence is supplied.

Neurologic disorder defined by recurrent nocturnal alternating hemiplegia, despite absence of persistent developmental impairment.
Gonococcal infection of the fallopian tubes; reproductive anatomy has no organ axis, but infection supplies a mechanism axis.
Functional endocrine pancreatic neoplasm secreting ACTH; no evidence establishes common direct damage to another organ.
Glycine metabolism disorder with seizures in 14/14 and developmental impairment; respiratory failure reflects central dysfunction, not established lung damage.
Defective steroidogenesis with adrenal insufficiency and defining skeletal malformations; skeletal abnormalities occur in 80-99%.
Umbrella concept explicitly affecting the small or large intestine; no extraintestinal involvement applies across the group.
Sclerosing bone dysplasia with increased bone density; extraskeletal organs and their frequencies are unspecified, so none are inferred.
Hereditary bipolar/major affective disorder is psychiatric; no neurologic tissue damage is established.
Mucoepidermoid carcinoma arising in the trachea, which belongs to the pulmonary axis.
Type E brachydactyly and atrial septal defect are defining skeletal and cardiac abnormalities.
Defective respiratory ciliary clearance with sinusitis in 8/9 and chronic bronchitis in 3/9. Otitis occurs in only 1/9; situs inversus alone is not cardiac damage.
Mitochondrial disease with villous atrophy and defining renal insufficiency; hepatic steatosis is characteristic. Later neurologic, ocular and ear involvement has unclear frequency.
Subchondral bone necrosis with osteochondral fragmentation and joint dysfunction; bone marrow edema here is skeletal, not hematologic disease.
